errors.text_span: Тази линия се покачва от 11,0% през 2007 г. до максимум 18,2% през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The description for "Уникредит Булбанк" is incorrect. The line starts at approximately 12.5% in 2007 (not 11.0%) and reaches its peak of about 17% around 2012-2013, not 18.2% in 2008.

errors.evidence: The description of the line for "ПИБ" is incorrect. It starts at ~7.5% in 2007 (not 11.2%) and ends at ~10.5% in 2026 (not 12.5%). The intermediate value is also wrong.

errors.evidence: The description of the line for "Пощенска банка" is incorrect. It starts at ~9.2% in 2007 (not 10.5%), has a local minimum in 2008 (not 2011), and ends at ~10.8% in 2026 (not 10.5%).
The legend label in the chart is "ОББ вкл. СИБ", not "ОББ фак. СИБ".
The line for "ОББ вкл. СИБ" is pink, not orange. The orange/peach line represents "Уникредит Булбанк".
